request: Keep the first desktop settings/API popup and remove the delayed second popup.
diagnosis: The QApplication tooltip policy sees ToolTip before the existing widget-level suppressor and schedules a native QToolTip over the custom HoverTooltip.
repair: Custom-popup anchors opt out of application native tooltip handling while retaining their native-event suppressor and accessible text. Claiming an anchor also cancels pending native-policy timers.

before.cause: Both actual event-delivery cases leave the native tooltip timer active after the custom popup owns the anchor.

verified_contracts: The first custom popup remains visible with its API link and help body.
Native tooltip events arriving before or after ownership produce no second native popup.
The anchor retains exactly its accessible tooltip text.
An ordinary unrelated tooltip still waits for the policy timer and shows its own text.
limitations: Qt offscreen verification, no native-desktop screenshot.
